comment: Recognition layer 2: community/district signs along the Airport Run route. Coordinates are real-world lat/lon; projected into world space at runtime via road.project(). needs_owner_review entries should be verified against the owner's lived knowledge — map data is a starting point only.

communities.name: Palisadoes
communities.note: The iconic coastal spit connecting the airport to Kingston — coconut palms, sea on both sides

communities.name: Harbour View
communities.note: Eastern gateway roundabout entering Kingston — potholes begin here

communities.name: Rockfort
communities.note: Historic fort and industrial Kingston — Windward Road entry

communities.name: Cross Roads
communities.note: Major Kingston junction — Maxfield Avenue, Half Way Tree bound

communities.name: Half Way Tree
communities.note: The commercial heart of uptown Kingston

communities.name: Spanish Town
communities.note: Historic capital of Jamaica — the route threads through on Wellington Street

communities.name: Bog Walk
communities.note: Gateway to the Rio Cobre gorge

communities.name: Linstead
communities.note: Market town — immortalised in the folk song 'Linstead Market'

communities.name: Ewarton
communities.note: Small town on the road up to Moneague

communities.name: Moneague
communities.note: Hill country junction — where the route turns north toward Ochi

communities.name: Cave Valley
communities.note: Hill country community on the northern descent

communities.name: Bamboo
communities.note: Famous Bamboo Avenue — giant bamboo arching over the road

communities.name: Fern Gully
communities.note: Hundreds of fern species lining the road down to Ochi

communities.name: Ocho Rios
communities.note: North coast resort town — end of the road
